(quinupristin) Adverse Effects and Treatment The adverse effects most frequently reported in pa- tients receiving quinupristin/dalfopristin include nau- sea and vomiting, diarrhoea, skin rash, pruritus, head- ache, and pain. Myalgia and arthralgia have occurred and may be severe; symptoms may be improved by de- creasing the dose frequency. Eosinophilia, anaemia, leucopenia, and neutropenia are also common.
